title: SB031 · The decision (source scene 23D)
subtitle: Emotion Resolve · s23-sh05 v4 (v2 + staggered waking) · s23-sh06 v3 push-in · Ranjith, 2026-11-10

panels.title: Crew wake one by one and gather (v2 + staggered)
beats: Same as approved v2 (its last frame shown); only the waking is staggered (L113, L114).
Wake: Raghavan 0.3 s, Babu 1.0 s, Sasi 1.6 s (half asleep); Aashaan turns his head inside.
Up: Raghavan 2.0 s to the rail first, Babu 2.8 s slower, Sasi last at 3.6 s; Antony runs in from the bow; Aashaan leans to the window.
5.5–8 s all at the right rail staring toward the bow; nobody moves to help.

panels.title: Antony: Call Aashaan. Bring a rope. (push-in)
beats: Antony, back to the left rail; behind him, right of centre, the burning vallam ~150 m off and Selvan's head and arm in the water (L86).
Camera: straight push-in from 2.0 m to 1.5 m at ~0.25 km/h, through the line, settling at 6 s (camera-exp).
0–2 s he turns from the sea to the crew; 2.5–5 s the order, just LEFT of the lens; 5–8 s silent, grips the rail, ready.

panels.title: Raghavan: Don't go.
beats: Raghavan MCU, deckhouse glow far behind; his hand reaches out below the frame and takes hold.
3–4 s the line, just RIGHT of the lens. 4–8 s silent; the wrist is pulled free, his hand comes up empty.

panels.title: Insert: Antony frees his wrist
beats: CU: Raghavan's old hand holding Antony's RIGHT wrist tightly on the rail top.
2.5–5 s Antony twists free; 5–8 s the old hand left open, then grips the rail.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: Crew and Antony at the LEFT rail (boat's port side) forward of the deckhouse; the burning vallam ahead-left; cameras c1 (sh05), c5 (sh06), c6 (sh07).
